mapper.select:
SELECT e.EXAM_SESSION, e.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY, e.CERT_CODE, c.CERT_NAME, c.CERT_INFO FROM CERT_EXAM e JOIN CERT c ON e.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE
WHERE c.CERT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY e.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY
SELECT GOV_PROJECT_CODE, GOV_PROJECT_NAME, POLICY_REGI_FIRSTDAY AS GOV_PROJECT_DATE, GOV_PROJECT_INFO, TARGET_CONDITION FROM GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY ORDER BY POLICY_REGI_FIRSTDAY

SELECT JOB_POSTING_CODE, JOB_POSTING_NAME, JOB_REGI_LASTDAY AS JOB_POSTING_DATE, RECRUITMENT_INFO FROM RECRUITMENT
WHERE JOB_POSTING_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY JOB_REGI_LASTDAY

SELECT GOV_PROJECT_CODE, GOV_PROJECT_NAME, POLICY_REGI_FIRSTDAY AS GOV_PROJECT_DATE, GOV_PROJECT_INFO, TARGET_CONDITION FROM GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY
WHERE GOV_PROJECT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY POLICY_REGI_FIRSTDAY

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT 'POLICY' AS allpcj, GOV_PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, GOV_PROJECT_NAME AS TITLE, POLICY_REGI_FIRSTDAY AS START_DATE, DATE_ADD(POLICY_REGI_LASTDAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS END_DATE, GOV_PROJECT_INFO AS INFO FROM GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CERT', CONCAT(e.CERT_CODE, '|', e.EXAM_SESSION), CONCAT(c.CERT_NAME, ' ', e.EXAM_SESSION), e.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY, DATE_ADD(e.EXAM_REGI_LASTDAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY), c.CERT_INFO FROM CERT_EXAM e JOIN CERT c ON e.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'JOB', JOB_POSTING_CODE, JOB_POSTING_NAME, JOB_REGI_FIRSTDAY, DATE_ADD(JOB_REGI_LASTDAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY), RECRUITMENT_INFO FROM RECRUITMENT ) t
WHERE t.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.START_DATE
SELECT e.EXAM_SESSION, e.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY, e.CERT_CODE, c.CERT_NAME, c.CERT_INFO FROM CERT_EXAM e JOIN CERT c ON e.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE ORDER BY e.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY
SELECT JOB_POSTING_CODE, JOB_POSTING_NAME, JOB_REGI_LASTDAY AS JOB_POSTING_DATE, RECRUITMENT_INFO FROM RECRUITMENT ORDER BY JOB_REGI_LASTDAY

SELECT 'POLICY' AS allpcj, GOV_PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, GOV_PROJECT_NAME AS TITLE, POLICY_REGI_FIRSTDAY AS START_DATE, DATE_ADD(POLICY_REGI_LASTDAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS END_DATE, GOV_PROJECT_INFO AS INFO FROM GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CERT', CONCAT(e.CERT_CODE, '|', e.EXAM_SESSION), CONCAT(c.CERT_NAME, ' ', e.EXAM_SESSION), e.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY, DATE_ADD(e.EXAM_REGI_LASTDAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY), c.CERT_INFO FROM CERT_EXAM e JOIN CERT c ON e.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'JOB', JOB_POSTING_CODE, JOB_POSTING_NAME, JOB_REGI_FIRSTDAY, DATE_ADD(JOB_REGI_LASTDAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY), RECRUITMENT_INFO FROM RECRUITMENT
ORDER BY START_DATE
